name: safer-with-jev
description: Public showcases of TypeSafe Jev judgments, with optional HTTPS forwarding after a pass.

scripts.dev:web: bun scripts/prepare-site.ts && bun run --filter web dev
scripts.build: bun scripts/prepare-site.ts && bun run --filter web build
scripts.typecheck: bun scripts/prepare-site.ts && tsc --noEmit && bun run --filter web typecheck
